text: Reception reported 89 of 183 rooms occupied on Friday 27 Nov (48.6%), 42 of them Rabdan (43 on 26 Nov). There was 1 check-in (room 312) and 1 check-out (room 806). No new inquiries, viewings, bookings or renewals were logged; Reception handled 1 walk-in guest and 5 guest complaints, all resolved, and Operations assisted 3 walk-in site visits for 1BHK and premium units.

All seven tracked reports for 27 Nov were received: Operations (plus the management office update), Housekeeping, Maintenance, HR & Accounts, the Flower shop, IT (sent on the morning of 28 Nov) and AJ1881. Accounts reported no overdue rent, no cheques deposited or returned and no supplier payments awaiting approval.

Accounts asked Tamouh Fire & Safety to complete the pending fire safety works urgently, stating that the fire alarm panel is currently shut down. Accounts also asked for approval to renew the lift AMC with Ever Gravity and to arrange an independent third-party lift inspection; Operations lists the lift issue and the hot water issue as still to be solved. Eight rooms are marked out of order and are to be inspected.

Maintenance logged 7 jobs, all marked done, including Basement 1 parking wall painting and fused lights, the guest lift 3 LED strip, the rooftop pool artificial plant panel, the 2nd-floor staircase trap door and basement lift lobby lamps. Still pending: ceiling painting in rooms 509–511, basement wall repair, the B2 drainage chamber cleaning and remaining basement lights. Housekeeping cleaned 12 rooms, parking levels 1–2 and half of level 3, all corridors and garbage rooms, the lobby and the pool area.

Waiting on management approval: the lift AMC (described as urgent), the flap barrier remote quotation, the room 710 FCU motor rewinding, the epoxy paint purchase, AJ1881’s supply purchases and its request to rename to Oui Cafe with a licence amendment, the room 801 guest’s refund request, the florist recruitment package and the Faiz Investment meeting. The Reneco Tawtheeq needs clarification, as an Abu Dhabi trade licence is required.

Operations attached the Oui Café and central kitchen, flower, swimming pool and laundry proposals; the car wash proposal is still pending. Operations followed up the NCTH flower contract signing and sent a corporate and events floral proposal, and LifeCore Clinic again asked for a bi-weekly quotation. On Rabdan, one group’s GRN is due by month-end and October’s payment has been received.

IT fixed the room 509 door and the room 808 TV and encoded key cards; new camera installation and the biometric attendance data are still pending, and the software is being installed on all company laptops. AJ1881 took AED 176 from 10 covers, serving beverages only; the flower shop reported no sales and finalised the supplier order for Sunday’s delivery.
